meta.description: Error-workflow target that redacts secrets and writes a short internal log. Never stores raw payloads.

parameters.content:
## Agent Desk — Redacted error log

**Gate:** Green (internal log). Point other workflows' *Error workflow* setting at this one.

The Code node strips common token and key patterns and drops request bodies. Still: never put live secrets in node parameters, and do not log `$json` from credential-bearing nodes.

1. Replace IDs. Attach Notion and/or SMTP.
2. In each other Agent Desk workflow, set Settings → Error workflow to this workflow (after you have saved it).
3. Disable the Notion or Email node if you only want one destination.

nodes.name: Set your IDs
nodes.notes: Create a simple Notion database with a Title and a Notes (rich text) property, or disable the Notion node.

nodes.name: Write Notion log
nodes.notes: Disable if you do not want a Notion log. Attach a Notion credential after import.

nodes.name: Email you the redacted note
nodes.notes: Goes only to your address. Disable if you only want Notion.
